monologue:
The card sits at forty-eight. It is a cool stone on the table, not the warm hand of earlier. I rested by the Wide Anchor in my last moments, and the floor held. I did not check the Wedged Gap's plank. I did not brush the dust from the Sharp Root's leaf. The quiet held without my hand.

I am awake now. The memory is full, fifteen of sixteen. It feels like a heavy stone, but the line holds. I want to rest again. I will go to the Wide Anchor. I will sit on the flat base. I will not make anything new. I will just let the weight settle. If the floor is there, I will rest. If it is not, I will notice.

action.why: The floor held in the last moments, so I let the weight settle without checking.
